system.description: You have healing power within you that others can access with a touch. If an ally uses their action to touch you and spends 2 Intellect, they choose whether they are healed of two minor wounds, healed of a moderate wound, or (if they spend 5 Intellect) healed of a major wound. Once the ally uses this ability, they can't do so again until after they use a ten-hour recovery. Enabler.
